metadata.title: 3 Questions to Answer Before a Possible Tesla and SpaceX Merger<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
There are 3 Questions to Answer Before a Possible Tesla and SpaceX Merger
For analysts and investors, a Tesla – SpaceX merger isn’t a question of if, but when. Still, there are a few questions to answer before Elon Musk’s trillion-dollar companies can become a vertically integrated artificial-intelligence behemoth.
